Angetrieben von dem Vermächtnis seiner verstorbenen Großmutter Anne begibt sich der Filmemacher Jonas Rothlaender auf die Reise, den Zerwürfnissen seiner eigenen Familie nachzuspüren. Nach jahrzehntelangem Schweigen trifft er in Zürich seinen Großvater Günther, der im Laufe seines Lebens mehrere Millionen in riskanten Börsenspekulationen veruntreut hat, darunter auch das gesamte Vermögen seiner damaligen Ehefrau Anne. Günther lebt 90-jährig, schwerkrank und völlig verarmt in einem Altersheim und ist besessen von dem Gedanken, seine "Schuld" zu begleichen bevor er stirbt. Er hat ein letztes großes Geschäft vor Augen. Doch als Bettina, Jonas Mutter und Günthers Tochter, in Zürich erscheint - in der Hoffnung sich endlich mit ihrem Vater zu versöhnen - ist Günthers Blick für das Wesentliche verstellt. (Driven by the legacy of his deceased grandmother Anne, filmmaker Jonas Rothlaender sets out on a journey to trace his own family's disputes. After decades of silence, he meets his grandfather Günther in Zurich, who embezzled several million in risky stock market speculations over the course of his life, including the entire fortune of his then wife Anne. Günther lives in a retirement home at the age of 90, seriously ill and completely impoverished, and is obsessed with the idea of paying off his “debt” before he dies. He has one last big business deal in mind. But when Bettina, Jonah's mother and Günther's daughter, arrives in Zurich - hoping to finally reconcile with her father - Günther's view of the essentials is obscured.

Driven by the legacy of his deceased grandmother Anne, filmmaker Jonas Rothlaender sets out on a journey to trace his own family's disputes. After decades of silence, he meets his grandfather Günther in Zurich, who embezzled several million in risky stock market speculations over the course of his life, including the entire fortune of his then wife Anne. Günther lives in a retirement home at the age of 90, seriously ill and completely impoverished, and is obsessed with the idea of paying off his “debt” before he dies. He has one last big business deal in mind. But when Bettina, Jonah's mother and Günther's daughter, arrives in Zurich - hoping to finally reconcile with her father - Günther's view of the essentials is obscured.
